tldr: Amazon’s planned Texas AI data center may rely on a gas plant with exceptionally high emissions, making power sourcing and regional sustainability constraints part of the hosting decision.
DeepMind’s open-source WeatherNext model reportedly gives forecasters an extra day of hurricane warning using lower-resolution input data.
OpenAI, AWS, Cursor, GitHub and Microsoft are backing Agent Plugins 1.0.0, a potentially useful portability standard for agent components.

top.title: Amazon’s Texas data center may rely on a huge polluting power plant
top.summary: Amazon is investing in an on-site gas-burning power plant for a planned West Texas data center that could reportedly become one of the largest single sources of greenhouse-gas emissions in the United States.
top.why: Include power availability, emissions reporting and sustainability constraints in data-center location and capacity decisions rather than treating electricity as an invisible dependency.

top.title: DeepMind’s open WeatherNext model gives hurricane forecasts an extra day
top.summary: DeepMind’s open-source WeatherNext model reportedly produced accurate hurricane predictions from lower-resolution weather data and gave forecasters an additional day of warning.
top.why: This is a practical example of a model improving outcomes while reducing input-data requirements, worth evaluating for forecasting workloads where bandwidth and data-pipeline cost matter.

top.title: OpenAI acquires presentation startup NextSlide
top.summary: OpenAI acquired presentation startup NextSlide, whose team members are now working on ChatGPT.
top.why: Expect more presentation-generation capability to arrive inside ChatGPT, but treat this as a product-roadmap signal rather than an immediate change to Azure model availability.

top.title: OpenAI, AWS and Microsoft back Agent Plugins 1.0.0
top.summary: OpenAI, AWS, Cursor, GitHub and Microsoft have backed Agent Plugins 1.0.0, a portable package format for reusable components that extend AI agents.
top.why: Track the standard before building a large proprietary skills ecosystem: broad adoption could reduce integration lock-in, while the early standard still needs security and lifecycle governance.

top.title: Cloudflare Precursor continuously detects bots and AI agents
top.summary: Cloudflare introduced Precursor, a client-side behavioral analysis engine that continuously examines interactions such as mouse movement and keyboard timing to detect sophisticated bots and AI agents without relying only on CAPTCHAs.
top.why: Add behavioral bot detection to the evaluation list for public AI endpoints, but validate its false-positive rate and privacy implications before making it part of the edge security design.
